utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: I would like to ask you, General, now to look at the document in tab 64. That is 65 ter 1D492, number, Macedonian page 1D4447, and the English page is 1D4451. This is headquarters, Ramno, that produced this information about the events that took place over that period of time, 10th of July, 2001. And as you can see, this document is addressed to the minister of the interior. My first question is: Whether this is the format of information that you at headquarters Ramno would produce informing the people that were to be recipients of this document or to whom you would need to communicate the information that the Ramno headquarters received?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is the format in which the headquarters Ramno would produce an information and distribute it to the persons whose names are on the last page of it.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: I would like to ask you now to look at page 1D4449 in Macedonian, and the English version is 1D4453.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, maybe this draft translation that we organised does not correspond fully to the Macedonian text, so I would like to ask you to bear with me when I read the part that might be of importance. Yes, we managed. The English page is 1D4453, that is the second paragraph from the top.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: You see here this part which reads: "In relation to operative action Ramno the following information have been received by the SVR Skopje." That is the very top in the English version. And after that, there is a paragraph, and after that that would be the last paragraph in the Macedonian version, while it would be the third paragraph in the English version which reads: "At 12.00 hours, PS Cair has received information from the person Zoran, that the persons Alimi Isni, Xevair Baki and Alimi Asbi, all from the village of Ljuboten, have participated in helping the NLA with weapons, cigarettes and other materials that they transported on cattle from Kosovo through the villages of Tanusevci and Brest to the village of Ljuboten, and after that, they would be delivered to the person Sulejman Nazmi, in the village of Aracinovo."

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, since the document was authenticated by the witness as a format that the operative action Ramno headquarters used for producing its information and since it contains relevant data about the NLA in the village of Ljuboten, I seek to tender this document in evidence as well.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Mr. Saxon.

utterances.speaker: MR. SAXON
utterances.text: Your Honour, the Prosecution will not object to the tendering of this document, just a point of clarification, that I believe the English translation needs to be corrected so that the date 2007 does not appear, so as not to create confusion at the top.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: And how do you propose that to be done?

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, this is a mistake in the English translation, and we're -- this is a draft translation and we're waiting for the final version and it is obvious that this is a typo because in the Macedonian version it is clearly -- that this is 2001. We will change this draft version as soon as we receive the final translation.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: The exhibit will be received in evidence, and the registry will substitute, when it is received, the formal translation for the interim one that is presently provided.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, this will be Exhibit 1D169.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: General, the attacks of NLA in the region of Skopje and the other major cities as Kumanov or Tetovo, is it correct that they became the basis of a mass KLA demonstration by the citizens that especially created problems in the maintaining of public law and order?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, especially after somebody got killed or a big event transpired.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: You talked about the fact that there were major events or demonstrations of the citizens in Bitola on the 26th of June in Skopje?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: However, what was characteristic of this was that citizens from other cities came to Skopje and this is where they would hold their demonstrations, either in front of the parliament or in front of the government building or other government institutions?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: So in Skopje at the end of July, the citizens from the Tetovo village demonstrated over thousands of people from Neprosteno and other villages came to Skopje and they demonstrated. And then, due to an anti-Albanian 13 sentiment that emerged among part of the people, a large number of buildings, private buildings of Albanians were damaged in the city of Skoplje.

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: And you know that scores -- that the police from Skopje detained scores of people from Skopje and criminal reports were filed against them?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: Also after several people were murdered by a mine planted close to Karpalak, there were major protests and demonstrations in the city of Skopje. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, not in Skopje, in Bitola.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: Bitola, I apologise. However, besides these that I just mentioned, is it correct that in Skopje in the settlement of Gorce Petrov on August 11, there were major demonstrations, protests of citizens, as a result of the murder of the soldiers who were killed near Ljubotenski Bacila?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: Would you please look at the document at tab 64.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's correction, it's tab 76.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] 65 ter D603, the Macedonian page is N004-9846, and the English translation is 65 ter 407, page N004-9846-ET.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: In front of you, you have the information from the Ministry of Interior, the analytics sector, that talks about these demonstrations in Skopje on the occasion of what had happened in the Ljubotenski Bacila. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: As you have mentioned yesterday, in order for the police to be able to establish the public law and order it had to undertake exceptional measures in order to protect the citizens, the parliament, the government facilities, and the consular and other foreign facilities in the country. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I seek to tender this document in evidence, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, this will be exhibit number 1D170.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: I would like to move on to a different topic now, General. Is it correct that the Macedonian authorities responded to this crisis and the attacks of sabotage and terrorist groups in two ways, so to speak. First, by responding to these attacks, they tried to destroy the terrorist groups or push them out of the territory of the Republic of Macedonia in those locations where they used violence and terror to threaten the system of the Republic of Macedonia or to attempt, so to speak, to wrest parts of the Republic of Macedonia from the rest of the country.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: However, parallel to this military and police activities, is it correct that the government and the bodies that had the authority in the Republic of Macedonia very early on they proposed that this crisis be solved in a peaceful manner?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: The president of the Republic, in the first half of June, offered a plan for a peaceful solution of the crisis. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: The government established a coordinated body that was responsible for managing the measures for the peaceful solution of the crisis in the country?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: An expert body was established - this was the crisis management centre?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: From the very beginning in the drafting of the plan, in its elaboration and implementation, the Macedonian government closely cooperated with the representatives of the international community. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: In the working groups that were producing the drafts of the plans, members of the NATO and other international organisations participated as well.

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: Until the beginning of July in 2001, all plans that were envisaged with the plan for the peaceful solution of the crisis were produced.

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, I would like to show the witness certain documents which are not in the first binder that I disseminated. I would like to ask the court usher to submit to the Chamber, the Prosecution the additional materials.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: General, I would like to ask you to look at the document at tab 81.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: 89, interpreter's correction.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] It is 65 ter 1D564. The page is 1D5163 in the Macedonian version, and 1D5169 in the English version.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: First of all, I would like to ask you whether it is true, General, that you have yourself participated in the working groups which were partially responsible for these documents, especially those that pertained to the deployment of the security forces?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: Now I would like to ask you whether you recognise this document, as a document that was supposed to be the plan and programme for overcoming the crisis in the Republic of Macedonia.

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that's what it was.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: Now I would like to ask you to look at the document at tab 90. That is the document 65 ter 1D565. This is page 1D5174, and the English version is 1D5191. This document is, as it is apparent, was created the 11th of June, 2001. Is it correct that it contains the proposals for measures of the organisation -- for the organisation and the efficiency of the crisis management system in the Republic of Macedonia which was produced in a close cooperation with the international community?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: Now I would like to look at the document at tab 91. This is document 65 ter 1D566, page 1D5204, in the Macedonian version, and the English version is 1D5210. This is the overview of the -- review of the working groups for the preparation of the operative plans. And behind you -- and for you in the police, it was of a special importance, it was especially important to determine the joint plan for the use of the security forces, and the plan for the redeployment of the police forces in the crisis regions and under NLA control. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it is correct.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: If we look at page 1D507 in the Macedonian, and in English that would be 1D513. So page 1D5213, 5213. And the Macedonian is 5207.

utterances.speaker: MR. SAXON
utterances.text: I'm sorry, if counsel could please indicate what tab we're working with now.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I apologise. Tab 91. The same tab. This is the third page that I just mentioned.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: This is the plan for which you were interested in, in the Ministry of the Interior, because it represented the preparation for the use of the joint forces -- for the joint security forces, and as you have mentioned yourself you participated as a representative of the Ministry of Interior in the -- as a member of this working group. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: As it is apparent, a NATO member was always present in this working group. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: Look tab 62.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: If the counsel can repeat the page.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] 65 ter 1D567, page is 1D5216. In the English version, it is 1D5221.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's correction, it's tab 92.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: This is the draft version, draft of the plan that your group produced for the use of the security forces. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: As it is apparent this working group of which you were participating occasionally, the draft was created at the time when representative -- the representative of the ministry was the Colonel --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: If the counsel can repeat the last name.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: We can see that the -- that a NATO Colonel and another Colonel from the British department of defence was participating?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Colonel Nikelevsi was from the sector of the public law and order in the department of police for the Ministry of Interior.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. Yet again, this confirms that in the -- in the preparation of the draft, representatives from the international community were always involved?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: If you look at the document at tab 94, it is 65 ter 1D569, page 1D5293 in the Macedonian version and 1D5245 -- 5245 in the English version? The draft that you produced were adopted by the coordinating body for crisis management and in front of us we see the minutes from each session held on July 9th, 2001. If we turn to page 1D5241 in the Macedonian version or 1D5247, we will see that on that day the session of this coordinative body in item -- in Article 5, line 3, the plan for using of these joint forces. Now I would like to ask you to look at document in tab 95. It is 65 ter 1D570, page 1D5251, and the English version is 1D5254. We can see that this is a note, the minutes from the meeting held between the deputy minister Ilija Filipovski and before I continue, Ilija Filipovski was at the same time the president of the coordinative body. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: And this is -- these are the minutes from the meeting held between Mr. Filipovski and the ambassador of the USA and the Republic of Macedonia Mr. Mike Einik. From this information, on page 5252 of the Macedonian version and 5255. In paragraph 2 in the Macedonian version it is apparent that the Ambassador Einik expressed his satisfaction with the achievements, that is, the adoption of these plans and that he would like to receive copies of the adopted operative plans as soon as possible for which he was assured by the deputy prime minister that they will be dispatched to him during the following day. He informed that they already have organised two check-points for building materials where there are means for the renovation of about 100 buildings in Tetovo and Kumanovo. Page 1 of this information, if we go back to it, we will see that in paragraph 3, the following text is present: "The deputy prime minister pointed out -- informed the ambassador that the coordinative body works in full capacity. The first three plans as he said, have already been produced and that soon it is expected that this happens with the fourth one." Would you agree with me that this fourth plan that took longer to be produced was exactly this plan for the use of the security forces?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: Now I would like you to look at the document at tab 96. It is 65 ter 1D571, and the English version is 1D5262. This is the plan for the use of security forces of the Republic of Macedonia that was adopted, and it was adopted right after the meeting with the ambassador of the United States, and it was already implemented. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: Now I would like to look at page 1D5260. And the title is management and control. In English it is 1D5265, command and control. Here we can see that the use of the special purposes unit proposed by the coordinative body is ordered by the president of the Republic of Macedonia. The commanding with the army of the Republic of Macedonia is under the competence of the president of the Republic and via the General Staff of the Macedonian army. And the commanding with the units of the Ministry of Interior affairs is under the competence of the president of the government of the Republic of Macedonia via the Minister of Interior Affairs. Would you agree with me, General, that this plan that was produced in the middle of July 2001 contains the manner of commanding with the police forces as it was envisaged by the new Law on Defence. Do you agree with me?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: However, is it correct that that, regardless of the fact that plan was produced and adopted, this plan for the use of the security forces for the Republic of Macedonia, the president of the Republic of Macedonia until the end of the crisis kept using his authority and issued orders both to the police, especially in the situations where the joint operations were organised?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: This is what the president did in his function as the chief commander of the Armed Forces, considering that the by-laws of the new law had not been passed yet. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: If we look at this document, and the practice about which you testify, could you be certain when you say that the use of the command and the management of the police was never in the hands of the minister. It was either in the hands of the president of the Republic or that was the -- under the authority of the president of the government of the Republic of Macedonia?

utterances.speaker: ZORAN JOVANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, at this moment I would -- I seek to tender these documents in evidence, and I think that maybe we can adjourn for today, that I can end with the interrogation. I can repeat these numbers.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: They will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, 65 ter 1D564 will be exhibit number 171. 65 ter 1D565 will be exhibit number 1D172. 65 ter 1D566 will be exhibit number 1D173. 65 ter 1D567 will be exhibit number 1D174. 65 ter 1D569 will be exhibit number 1D175. 65 ter 1D570 will be exhibit number 1D176. And, finally, 65 ter 1D571 will be exhibit number 1D177.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: That last number should be 177 rather than 1766. Ah, it is being corrected. We will therefore adjourn for the day. We resume tomorrow at 2.15 for the trial.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Friday, the 14th day of September, 2007, at 2.15 p.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 6.56 p.m.,
